title: Khaemenes Science Continuum
description: Shared public science-learning contract for early learning through high school. Course content remains owned by its source repository and must be independently reviewed before standards, credit, or mastery claims.

ownership.courseAuthority: Each course repository owns lessons, assessments, student records, and course-level mastery.
ownership.noSinglePointOfFailure: A missing shared metadata file must not block access to a published course.
ownership.archiveRule: Historical snapshots are not runtime dependencies.

pathways.knownCoverage: Grades 2-5 have 36-week science subject directories. Grade 1 is being added in the current rollout.
Integrated Science 9, Biology 10, Chemistry 11, and Physics & Engineering 12 course pathways are present.
Science-adjacent early-learning applications include weather and moon-phase exploration; a full formal scope and sequence remains to be mapped.

evidencePrinciples: distinguish direct observations from predictions, interpretations, models, and inferences
record measurement units and methods when measurements are used
require reasoning appropriate to the learner's developmental stage
use safe supervised investigations or a documented data/model alternative
preserve learner-authored work and identify source or mentor contributions
do not equate activity completion with verified mastery
provide accessible and printable alternatives wherever practical

mastery.rule: An essential outcome remains gated until the learner reaches the 80% mastery target or completes the course-approved correction and reassessment path.
mastery.authority: The course assessment system, not shared metadata or a study-support tool, determines formal course mastery.

standardsPolicy.benchmark: Use NGSS three-dimensional learning as a planning reference where appropriate.
standardsPolicy.honesty: Do not claim jurisdictional compliance or external accreditation until exact standards and requirements are verified.
standardsPolicy.mappingRequired: Course maps should identify taught objectives, practice, evidence, assessment, and verified standards where available.

safetyPolicy: Never taste unknown materials or living things.
Use adult supervision for cutting tools, heat, electricity, chemicals, field collection, and other hazards.
Do not mix household cleaners or unknown chemicals.
Offer observation, simulation, or supplied-data alternatives when materials or supervision are unavailable.
